summary: Tested all 4 new StyleScan v2 features end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass in test_stylescan_v2.py covering (a) POST /api/upload returns {path} for multipart PNG, (b) GET /api/files/{path} returns exact original bytes with image/* content-type and 404 for missing paths, (c) POST /api/conversations/{id}/chat with image_path runs Claude vision (correctly identified an uploaded brown/espresso PNG) and persists user message with image_path set, (d) PATCH /api/conversations/{id} renames (trimmed to 60 chars) and toggles pinned; GET /api/conversations returns pinned first then updated_at desc; 400 on empty body; 404 on bad id, (e) POST /api/saved is idempotent (same message_id returns same look id), 404 on unknown message_id; GET /api/saved lists; DELETE soft-deletes and second DELETE returns 404. Frontend (Playwright, mobile viewport 390x844): app loads, composer visible; camera icon opens Add-a-photo sheet with Take a photo / Choose from library / Cancel (all 3 present and dismissable); top-bar bookmark icon opens the Saved screen; a sent prompt streams a full Claude reply and the assistant bubble exposes Save + Share actions; tapping Save flips the label to 'Saved' with filled icon and the entry appears on the Saved screen (2 cards, each with Share/Open chat/Delete controls); tapping 'Open chat' navigates back to that conversation (composer + prior messages visible); History screen shows every row with pin, rename (edit-2), and delete controls; renaming via the modal updates the title live ('TEST_Renamed_Session'); pinning marks the row with a filled bookmark and floats it to the top of the list (verified visually — pinned rows sort before unpinned rows, and within pinned rows updated_at desc holds). Regression: streaming reply renders cleanly with no dropped characters, **bold** is rendered bold.

issues: Pinned vs unpinned bookmark icon differs only by color (onSurface vs muted) and both use the same 'bookmark' icon on the row action button (see history.tsx:99-103). It's readable but subtle; consider swapping to 'bookmark' (filled) for pinned and outline variant for unpinned, or slightly rotating the pinMark, for stronger affordance.

action_items: (Optional) Strengthen the visual difference between pinned and unpinned rows in history.tsx (currently only color changes).
(Optional, low priority) Class-scoped pytest fixture in TestSavedLooks uses instance method; will be removed in pytest 10. Convert to @classmethod or module-scoped.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/upload correctly runs put_object in a threadpool (blocking requests call) and re-initializes storage_key on 503, matching the object-storage playbook.
Chat endpoint properly stores image_path on the user message BEFORE streaming, and loads the image bytes via get_object then base64-encodes for ImageContent — vision path is sound.
PATCH /conversations sorts safely: strips + truncates title to 60, 400 when body is empty, 404 on unknown id.
POST /saved is genuinely idempotent (queries by message_id + deleted_at:null and returns existing).
Frontend api.ts uploadImage handles both web (blob) and native (RN FormData file shape) — matches the platform toggle.
MessageBubble hides Save/Share while streaming (showActions gates on !streaming) — no half-baked actions during token stream.
Composer preview shows a spinner overlay during upload and only enables send once image_path is set — good UX guardrail.
Header stacks 3 icon buttons (menu / bookmark / edit); all touch targets are 44x44.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates/soft-deletes transient conversations and one saved-look; a few renamed/pinned rows remain from live UI testing (expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_stylescan_v2.py; the _make_png_bytes helper synthesizes a minimal PNG for /api/upload without external assets. On the web preview, Expo Router keeps the previous screen mounted underneath the new one — testIDs like [data-testid="open-history-button"] can match >1 nodes across screens; always use `.last` (or `:visible`) to target the currently active screen. Native camera/library file-picking cannot be exercised in the web preview; only verify the photo-source sheet opens and the upload API works.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no regressions or bugs found. All 9 items in the review request pass on both backend and frontend.
